description: This file defines the ShellFileVersionProvider class, which implements file versioning by generating hash-based version strings for static files in an OrchardCore application. It manages caching and cache sharing across tenants and modules.

classes.name: ShellFileVersionProvider
classes.description: Provides version hash for static files, implementing IFileVersionProvider, with caching and hash generation logic.

methods.name: ShellFileVersionProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing file providers and cache.

methods.name: AddFileVersionToPath
methods.description: Adds a version hash query parameter to a file path if the file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: GetHashForFile
methods.description: Generates a SHA256 hash for a given file info object.
